quotes: Before admitting the first visitor, the organizer must give the agency either a signed paper inspection record or an electronic inspection record signed by the inspecting officer.
Each record must identify the display, the inspection date, and every public exit inspected.
For a temporary display open to the public after sunset on agency premises, the organizer must satisfy all of the following conditions:
claim_judgments.rationale: Evidence shows that the focus source text F000 provides two alternative inspection record formats: either a signed paper inspection record or an electronic inspection record signed by the inspecting officer. Claim C0006 omits the electronic record alternative entirely from its summary and choice_text, stating only that the organizer must give a signed paper inspection record, which misrepresents a disjunctive option as an exclusive mandate. Consequently, summary, alternatives, and object are in error. Support is scored as error because the cited source text does not support the claim that a paper record is mandatory. The actor (the organizer), modality (must), action (give), and scope (temporary display after sunset on agency premises, prior to first visitor) are faithfully retained. Boundary correctly spans [756, 1032). Graph links have no incorrect targets, and thresholds, concepts, source attribution, and effectivity are not applicable as no quantitative thresholds, taxonomy tags, attributing sources, or explicit in-force periods exist in the text.

unit_judgments.rationale: Unit U0006 requires providing an inspection record in one of two permissible formats (a signed paper record or an electronic record signed by the inspecting officer). Linked claim C0006 partially covers this unit but contains a significant meaning and representation error by omitting the electronic record format alternative and presenting the paper record as mandatory. Therefore, the unit is only partially covered.
